sentences.en: Will humanity be able to prevent the degradation of ecosystems?
sentences.zh: 人类能够阻止生态系统的退化吗？

sentences.en: Introducing foreign plants, such as palm trees can damage ecosystems.
sentences.zh: 引入外来植物，比如棕榈树可能会破坏生态系统。

sentences.en: Rising noise levels can negatively impact ocean animals and ecosystems.
sentences.zh: 噪音水平上升会对海洋动物和生态系统产生负面影响。
